content: Incorporating a systematic approach to assess, adopt, and integrate technology into Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) can significantly enhance access to care and promote equitable health outcomes. Technology-enabled solutions, such as virtual health platforms, digital coaching, and continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), are increasingly utilized to support diabetes self-management. These tools provide patients with the ability to monitor their condition in real time and receive immediate feedback, which can improve their ability to manage their diabetes effectively. This structured approach ensures that technological advancements are accessible and consistently applied across all patient groups. Such an approach is particularly advantageous for diverse populations, including those with varying levels of health literacy, as it helps bridge gaps in care and ensures equitable access to diabetes management resources.
